Subject: Your divorce by mutual consent matter - Petition No. 787/2020

Dear Ms. Bose,

Thank you for meeting us on 26 February 2021 about your dispute with Pranav Kapoor. As we understand it, the couple has a young child. The matter is listed before the Family Court at Madurai.

Our advice is to agree a joint parenting plan before the second motion. Please collect the school records of the child and the draft parenting plan and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of ₹74,20,000.

Regards,
Adv. Kunal Bhagat
